dedupe_keys.name: stream it uc 06 01 day ahead schedule for water pump opeartion

description: The STREAM project deposits three day-ahead water-pump schedules from its Italian pilot. The public CC BY 4.0 Zenodo record lists separate CSVs for electricity-price minimisation, greater local photovoltaic use and transformer-congestion avoidance. The provider says each case covers a 24-hour horizon at 15-minute resolution, with time, the relevant price or power signal, baseline pump power and optimised pump power; the congestion case also gives transformer loading after the change. A modeller could use these paired schedules to test how water-system pumping shifts electricity demand under different local-grid objectives. They are optimisation results for one test case, not an executable pump-control model or evidence that storage and pressure constraints hold in another network. The page does not give pump capacity, hydraulic state, units or exact study day. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this three-case output set. The CSV files were not downloaded, so schedule feasibility and values remain unchecked.
